review_artifact.root_cause: The GET /users/{user_id} route called get_user without translating the service layer's domain NotFoundError into FastAPI's HTTPException, so missing users escaped as internal server failures.
review_artifact.behavior_fixed: The route now catches only NotFoundError and raises HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=str(exc)). Existing users still return HTTP 200, missing users return 404 with detail "user not found", and unrelated RuntimeError exceptions remain unconverted.

verification_results.result: Passed: existing user returned 200 with the expected payload; missing user returned 404 with exactly {"detail":"user not found"}; RuntimeError for user 999 propagated.
